# Pro Rig Builder

> PC part comparison and upgrade tool. Compare prices across Amazon, Newegg, and Best Buy. Scan your PC to get personalized upgrade recommendations.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://prorigbuilder.com/): Compare PC part prices across retailers
- [PC Builder](https://prorigbuilder.com/builder): Build a full PC with live prices
- [Upgrade Tool](https://prorigbuilder.com/upgrade): Scan your PC and get upgrade recommendations
- [Browse GPUs](https://prorigbuilder.com/parts/gpu): Graphics card price comparison
- [Browse CPUs](https://prorigbuilder.com/parts/cpu): Processor price comparison
- [What Can I Upgrade](https://prorigbuilder.com/what-can-i-upgrade): Upgrade guide

## About

- Pro Rig Builder is a project by TieredUp Tech, Inc.
- Prices update daily from retailer APIs.
